_comment: Rare plants to take a cutting of and grow at home (scripts/world/home_life.gd, scripts/world/cutting_spot.gd). `near` and `offset` work like data/world/found_parts.json: a job site (site:<id>) or photo spot (photo:<id>), then metres east, up and south. Walk up to the plant and press F to take a cutting. `rumour` shows in the phone's Leads tab until you have it.

cuttings.name: Kangaroo paw
cuttings.rumour: A clump of red-and-green kangaroo paw grows by the path off Fraser Avenue in Kings Park. Nobody would miss one cutting.

cuttings.name: Geraldton wax
cuttings.rumour: The little nursery by the Fremantle Markets lets you snip a bit of their Geraldton wax if you ask.

cuttings.name: Frangipani
cuttings.rumour: A frangipani has gone wild on a neglected verge along Bulwer Street. A stick of it would root in a pot.
